history.sg_progress: In order to address this recommendation, the Administration will proceed as follows: (a) In the short term, the goal will be to find alternative solutions, such as further instructing entities to ensure that they indicate the temporary job opening numbers in the remarks of the personnel action. The Administration and the United Nations Joint Staff Pension Fund agreed that the Pension Fund would create a dedicated email account that the Business Transformation and Accountability Division would use on a regular basis to request that the Pension Fund confirm whether the identified staff members/consultants or individual contractors were in receipt of a pension benefit; (b) In the long term, the goal will be to improve the linkages among information systems to enable automated comparisons, in order to support monitoring and to explore the possibility of enhancing Inspira to facilitate the automated verifications for temporary job opening situations. Should other enhancements be identified as required in Umoja or Inspira, they will also be brought to the attention of the relevant Boards as part of the approach to continuous improvements. With regard to the automatic verifications against Pension Fund data on current retirees, the Administration would like to underline that the Secretariat is not in a position to impose such a change to the Pension Fund system.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration address deficiencies in the linkages among information systems to better support the monitoring of exceptions in coordination with the enterprise resource planning teams.
history.administration_response: As part of the monitoring of exceptions to human resources administrative instructions, the Business Transformation and Accountability Division receives a file from the United Nations Joint Staff Pension Fund on a quarterly basis. Discussions are ongoing with regard to receiving this file automatically and more frequently. A quarterly extract of relevant data from Umoja and Inspira is produced manually by the Division, and the information is used to check that entities are reporting exceptions to human resources administrative instructions. Discussions are under way to assess possibilities to automate the data extraction. However, linkages among or the integration of systems will require additional dedicated resources.
history.board_assessment: Given that the monitoring of exceptions still relies mainly on manual work and that linkages among or the integration of systems will require additional dedicated resources, the Board considers this recommendation to be under implementation.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration address deficiencies in the linkages among information systems to better support the monitoring of exceptions in coordination with the enterprise resource planning teams.
history.administration_response: The Administration has initiated the request for the development of data models in SAP HANA with data from the exception log, with a daily refresh to get the most current data. This will require the inclusion of exception log data in the client relations management data warehouse, which will then be integrated into SAP HANA. The data models in SAP HANA will be analysed to determine whether additional data is needed from Umoja, Inspira or the information technology system used by the United Nations Joint Staff Pension System. The Business Transformation and Accountability Division is coordinating this with the Office of Human Resources, the Office of Information and Communications Technology and the Enterprise Resource Planning Solution Division as needed.
history.board_assessment: Given that the development of data modules for the monitoring of exceptions is still in progress, the Board considers this recommendation to be under implementation.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration address deficiencies in the linkages among information systems to better support the monitoring of exceptions in coordination with the enterprise resource planning teams.
history.administration_response: The Administration would like to request that the Board consider this recommendation to be overtaken by events. Since the recommendation was made, exception log data has been exported at least once a quarter and loaded into SAP HANA to be used for assessing progress towards human resources key performance indicators and other monitoring activities. Job opening data loaded into HANA from Inspira are also refreshed daily and queried at least quarterly for analysis and monitoring. The Business Transformation and Accountability Division and the United Nations Joint Staff Pension Fund had looked into the Pension Fund interface needed to obtain information on pension benefits every quarter. The Pension Fund did not agree to develop the interface, and the low volume of staff pension benefits to confirm on a quarterly basis (ranging from fewer than 10 to approximately 25) did not justify the effort. Instead, the information is being requested from the Pension Fund every quarter, and monitoring has continued.
history.board_assessment: Given that the supplier failed to propose a workable solution, and due to financial constraints, management decided that manual operations suffice for current needs. The Board therefore considers the recommendation to be overtaken by events.
